ADOPTED_ASSET_MISMATCH: The piece's main image and views must match what's currently adopted. Reload and try again.
ASSET_NAME_TOO_LONG: The image name is too long.
ASSET_NOT_FOUND: Couldn't find this image on your computer.
ASSET_TARGET_MISMATCH: The image has to belong to the same piece.
ASSET_VIEW_MISMATCH: This image's view doesn't match the job. Import it with the job's view.
BRIEF_TOO_LONG: The description can't be longer than 12,000 characters.
CANDIDATE_CLOSED: This image can't be adopted right now.
CANVAS_ANNOTATION_NOT_FOUND: Couldn't find this note on the canvas.
CANVAS_ANNOTATION_INVALID: This note couldn't be saved. Check its text, color and position.
HASH_MISMATCH: The image doesn't match what Codex reported.
HOST_NOT_ALLOWED: AIDOL only accepts connections from this computer (localhost).
IMMUTABLE_CHARACTER_ID: A character's ID can't be changed.
INVALID_CANVAS_ANNOTATION: This note couldn't be saved. Check its text, color and position.
INVALID_CHARACTER: The character file has a problem. Check the required fields and value types.
INVALID_CODEX_OUTPUT: Codex replied, but not in a format AIDOL can read. Your settings weren't changed. You can try again.
INVALID_HANDOFF: This job's link to Codex is no longer valid. Send it to Codex again from AIDOL.
INVALID_ID: The ID isn't in a valid format.
INVALID_IMAGE: Use a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF image whose contents match its format.
INVALID_IMAGE_SIZE: The image can't be empty and must be smaller than 25 MB.
INVALID_INPUT: AIDOL couldn't accept this change. Check what you entered and try again.
INVALID_MANIFEST: The images Codex sent back don't match this job.
INVALID_NAME: Enter a name between 1 and 160 characters.
INVALID_OUTPUT_VIEW: This view isn't available for this character or piece.
INVALID_PRIMARY_VIEW: A main image can't be a back or detail view. Save it to that view instead.
INVALID_PROGRESS: Codex sent a progress update AIDOL doesn't recognize.
INVALID_PROMPT: Write a request of up to 12,000 characters.
INVALID_VARIANTS: You can draw 1, 2 or 4 images at a time.
INVALID_YAML: The YAML couldn't be read. Check indentation, duplicate keys and references.
JOB_ENDED: This job has ended. Start a new one.
JOB_TARGET_MISMATCH: The image has to match the job's piece and purpose.
LIMIT_FILE_SIZE: Images must be smaller than 25 MB.
MISSING_OUTFIT: This character has several outfits. Pick the one to use for this job.
MISSING_REFERENCE: A reference image for this job isn't ready yet. Try again once it's ready.
MISSING_REVISION: The current version of the character is missing.
NO_PORTRAIT: Pick a main illustration before breaking down the outfit.
ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED: This website isn't allowed to access your characters.
PROPOSAL_CLOSED: This suggestion has already been handled.
REVISION_CONFLICT: The character has changed since you opened it. Reload and try again.
STALE_PROPOSAL: The version this suggestion was based on is gone. Ask the AI again.
UNKNOWN_ASSET: This refers to an image that doesn't exist.
UNKNOWN_COMPONENT: This refers to a piece that doesn't exist.
UNKNOWN_SWATCH: An outfit uses a palette color that doesn't exist.
UNSUPPORTED_JOB_KIND: This kind of job isn't supported.
VIEW_ASSET_MISMATCH: A view has to use an image of the same view.
INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong in AIDOL's local service. Try again in a moment.
CODEX_UNAVAILABLE: Can't reach the Codex CLI on this computer. Make sure Codex is installed and signed in. AIDOL won't change your sign-in.
CODEX_OPEN_FAILED: Couldn't open Codex App. Make sure Codex App is installed and signed in, then try again.
DECOMPOSE_TIMEOUT: Codex took too long to look at the image. Try again in a moment.
DECOMPOSE_NEEDS_CODEX: Automatic outfit breakdown needs the Codex CLI installed and signed in. You can also add pieces by hand on the canvas.
TRASH_NOT_FOUND: Couldn't find this character in the trash.
PROJECT_EXISTS: A character with the same ID already exists, so it can't be restored to its original place.
INVALID_TRASH_ID: The trash item ID isn't in a valid format.
PROJECT_BUSY: Another program has the character's folder open, so it can't be moved (it isn't AIDOL itself). Close Codex App, File Explorer or any editor and try again.
PROJECT_BUSY_CODEX: AIDOL's Codex is still working (for example on a chat or an outfit breakdown), so it can't let go of the character's folder yet. Try again once it finishes.
DECOMPOSE_INTERRUPTED: The outfit breakdown was interrupted when the character was deleted. You can run it again.
